data.name: WelcomeBody
data.value: Join a friend's game server with an invite. Only the game connection goes through 1Salem Connect; the rest of this PC's internet traffic is left alone.

data.name: NotConfiguredDetail
data.value: This copy of 1Salem Connect has no service address, so it cannot join servers. Install the official release of 1Salem Connect.

data.name: InviteBody
data.value: Paste the invite link or code that the server owner sent you.

data.name: InviteNotValid
data.value: This invite isn't valid. Ask the server owner for a new one.

data.name: WaitingBody
data.value: The owner of {0} needs to approve this PC. This page checks by itself, and you can close the app and come back later.

data.name: WaitingStatus
data.value: Waiting for the owner to approve…

data.name: WaitingDeclined
data.value: The server owner declined this request.

data.name: ServersEmpty
data.value: You haven't joined any servers yet.

data.name: StatusConfirmationPending
data.value: Waiting for the owner to finish setting up this PC

data.name: StatusConfirmationFailed
data.value: Setting up this PC failed — ask the owner to invite you again

data.name: ConnectionAddressHint
data.value: In Minecraft, open Multiplayer, choose Direct Connection and enter this address.

data.name: ErrorBrokerUnreachable
data.value: Can't reach 1Salem Connect. Check your internet connection and try again.

data.name: ErrorTooManyAttempts
data.value: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.

data.name: ErrorDeviceNotAccepted
data.value: This PC couldn't be verified. Check that its date and time are correct, then try again.

data.name: ErrorTransportUnavailable
data.value: The connection component isn't working. Restart 1Salem Connect, and reinstall it if this keeps happening.

data.name: ErrorTransportUntrusted
data.value: Another program answered in place of 1Salem Connect's connection component, so nothing was sent to it. Close other copies of 1Salem Connect or restart this PC, then try again.

data.name: ErrorSetupFailed
data.value: Setting up this server failed. Ask the server owner to approve this PC again.

data.name: ErrorIdentityUnavailable
data.value: This PC's saved 1Salem Connect identity can't be opened by this Windows user, so this PC has to be paired again. Pairing again is not available in this version yet.

data.name: ErrorSessionLost
data.value: The connection stopped. Connect again to continue.

data.name: ErrorCloseUnconfirmed
data.value: The connection couldn't be closed yet, so the address may still work. 1Salem Connect keeps trying; you can also press Disconnect again.

data.name: ErrorUnexpected
data.value: Something went wrong. Technical details are in Diagnostics.

data.name: DiagnosticsBody
data.value: Technical details for troubleshooting. Keys, tickets and invite codes are removed before anything is shown or copied.

data.name: DiagnosticsFakeMode
data.value: fake, node id {0} (self-asserted, not a security boundary)

data.name: DiagnosticsSessions
data.value: Sessions (id, local, state, host bridge, connections)

data.name: UpdatesStatusInstalling
data.value: Installing the update. 1Salem Connect will close and open again.

data.name: UpdatesProblemUnreachable
data.value: GitHub could not be reached. Check your internet connection and try again.

data.name: UpdatesProblemNoInformation
data.value: No update information is published for the newest release yet.

data.name: UpdatesProblemInvalid
data.value: The update information could not be trusted, so nothing was downloaded.

data.name: UpdatesProblemDownload
data.value: The download did not complete. Nothing was changed. Try again.

data.name: UpdatesProblemHash
data.value: The downloaded file did not match the official release, so it was deleted and not run.

data.name: UpdatesProblemCancelled
data.value: The update was cancelled. Nothing was changed.

data.name: UpdatesProblemLaunch
data.value: The installer could not be started. Nothing was changed. Try again.

data.name: UpdatesAdminNote
data.value: Windows asks for administrator permission only to replace the app's files. Your invitations, servers and settings stay as they are.

data.name: UpdatesDisconnectDetail
data.value: You are connected to a server. Updating closes 1Salem Connect, so the connection would end.

data.name: UpdatesDisconnectFailed
data.value: The connection could not be closed yet. Try again in a moment.

data.name: UpdatesPortableAvailable
data.value: A newer portable version is available.

data.name: UpdatesPortableDetail
data.value: This copy runs without being installed, so it is not replaced automatically. Download the new portable package and replace this folder yourself, or install 1Salem Connect to get automatic updates.

data.name: UpdatesPortableNote
data.value: Portable copy: updates are not installed automatically.

data.name: NoticeUpdateFailed
data.value: The update to Build {0} did not finish. 1Salem Connect is unchanged and still works.

data.name: NoticeUpdateBlocked
data.value: The update to Build {0} could not start because 1Salem Connect was still open in another window. Close every 1Salem Connect window and try again.

data.name: NoticeUpdateInProgress
data.value: An update is being installed. 1Salem Connect will open again when it finishes.
